competitors.gap: Cites NEJM and Lancet but gives no side-effect numbers, no half-life figure, nothing by sex, and only 'not yet FDA-approved' with no filing date.
A single abstract: no mechanism synthesis across receptor, brainstem and trial evidence, and nothing on status after 2023.
Commercial supplement retailer; mixes benefits with dosing guidance and has no per-claim citations.
News on CagriSema REDEFINE 1 only; nothing on cagrilintide alone, the half-life or the brainstem mechanism.

information_gain: The only page that answers the 'for men' query from the trials themselves (share of men enrolled per trial, and the plain statement that no sex-split results are published) and ties the mechanism to the 2026 cross-species brainstem atlas and the measured 159-195 hour half-life.
serp_format_rewarded: Explainer with AI Overview and People Also Ask; image packs and video; definitional first paragraph plus a mechanism section and FAQ.
